_note: The earlier protocol's calibration lists. run_eval.py --subsets full --split eval drops each dataset's 'calibration' sequences from its frame maps. The paper's own evaluation and calibration subsets are in paper/ (the default of run_eval.py and calibration/calibrate.py). Extracted from the authors' research codebase (the calibration lists and evaluation maps of the earlier protocol's runs).

co3d.eval_note: the other 40 sequences (8 categories) = the earlier protocol's co3d_eval_s0 map exactly (checked)

re10k.eval_note: the other 190 sequences = the earlier protocol's re10k_eval_s0 map exactly (checked). The paper's tables used 38 of them (every fifth in sorted order) and calibrated on these 10 plus 20 more outside the 38: paper/re10k.json, paper/calibration.json.

7scenes.eval_note: test sequences (TestSplit.txt), 18 in the manifest; the paper's runs used all 18 (its Supp. Tab. 12 says 10, a wrong count: paper/7scenes.json). Calibration uses separate train sequences (dataset 7scenes_train: first TrainSplit sequence of each scene, eval/data/sevenscenes.py --split train).

tum_dynamic.eval_note: 8 fr3 dynamic sequences. Calibration uses separate takes (dataset tum_dynamic_train: walking_xyz/halfsphere/rpy_validation, sitting_xyz_validation).
